title: Hyperthermia for Treatment of Cancer
item_service_description: <p> Local hyperthermia for treatment of cancer consists of the use of heat to make tumors more susceptible to cancer therapy measures.</p>
indications_limitations: <p> Local hyperthermia is covered under Medicare when used in connection with radiation therapy for the treatment of primary or metastatic cutaneous or subcutaneous superficial malignancies. It is not covered when used alone or in connection with chemotherapy.</p>
